With a big hurricane closing up on us it is an emergency for our intersection and we sit in the bottom of the street.

During Thursdays big rain storm, Forrester Street where it meets Emerton St, surrounding our front yard, was some terrible flooding, knee deep. This used to happen a lot with nearly every big rain, especially in a high tide, but the many-years broken tidal gate was finally fixed and we haven't seen it in awhile. We, along with neighbors, have lost cars and everything in our basements in the past. This recent storm was disturbing because it was low tide at the height of the rain but the storm drains couldn't handle all the water. I am concerned there is an issue again with the gate or some other malfunction below ground.
